name: Aqua MODIS (OBPG)
scope: 16 reflective band-average responses as used by NASA OBPG. Labels are provider wavelengths, not MODIS band numbers. This is not all 36 MODIS bands or detector-specific MCST data. The provider tabulation includes weak out-of-band tails; full coverage is required unless partial integration is explicit.
preprocessing: Convert wavelength units to nm; sort out-of-order provider rows and record that fact; reject duplicate wavelengths; replace negative measured responses with zero and record counts/minima; trim only exact zero tails, retaining one zero shoulder. No Gaussian approximation, wavelength resampling or peak/area normalization. Response is not inferred outside the provider tabulation.
